target.title: add whatsapp outbound token diagnostics
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Outbound WhatsApp direct sends can fail silently when WhatsApp Web needs trusted-contact token state or LID routing data for a recipient.

AI-assisted: yes, Codex helped update this branch and evidence.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds outbound token diagnostics and LID-aware lookup paths around WhatsApp Web sends.

The send path now:

- resolves phone-number targets through Baileys LID lookup and USync when possible
- persists discovered PN/LID mappings for later sends
- checks trusted-contact token state before direct sends
- reports reachout timelock and new-chat quota diagnostics when a token is missing
- keeps socket operations bounded by the existing WhatsApp socket timing wrapper
- lets token-backed direct sends pass the monitor reachout-timelock gate

## User Impact

Users get clearer failures instead of accepted-but-undelivered direct WhatsApp sends, and already-known LID mappings are reused for later outbound messages.

## Evidence

Current head: `90e3f0c4c3f820c7da0fa8c0c60e9b3f2b99cf36`

Focused validation on the current base:

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-whatsapp.config.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/inbound/send-api.test.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/socket-timing.test.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/monitor-inbox.behavior.test.ts
Test Files  3 passed (3)
Tests       149 passed (149)
```

```text
$ node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.extensions.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions-test.tsbuildinfo
# exit code 0
```

```text
$ git diff --check
# exit code 0
```

```text
$ codex review --base origin/main
No actionable correctness, security, or maintainability regressions were found in the reviewed diff. Focused WhatsApp tests for the changed send API, socket timing, and monitor support passed.
```

Broader WhatsApp extension validation after the token-backed send fix:

```text
$ pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false test:extension whatsapp
Test Files  87 passed (87)
Tests       1040 passed (1040)
```

```text
$ node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs extensions/whatsapp/src/inbound/monitor.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/inbound/send-api.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/inbound/send-api.test.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/socket-timing.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/socket-timing.test.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/monitor-inbox.test-harness.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/monitor-inbox.streams-inbound-messages.test-support.ts
# exit code 0
```
